// Solver parameters for a deformable (soft) body. VolumeCompliance and
// DeformationCompliance are inverse stiffnesses in meters per newton
// (0 = rigid response); Damping is the velocity decay rate in units of one
// per second; SolverIterations is the constraint iteration count per step.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soft-body_dynamics)
type SoftBodySettings
    implements IValue
{
    VolumeCompliance: Number;
    DeformationCompliance: Number;
    Damping: Number;
    SolverIterations: Integer;
}
